repoFindings: FateGear runtime owns authoritative state in SceneRuntime, SessionMapState, StoryState, TurnResolution, and RuntimeEvent.
Narration memory already exists as non-authoritative VectorMemory retrieved by NarrationPipeline and guarded by NarrationValidator.
InMemoryVectorContextStore currently loses memories across process boundaries and has no audit/search/forget surface.

priorityArchetypeMapping.FateGearUse: Write memory from committed game/narration flow, scoped by session/module/player/persona, with retrieve/write/forget operations that feel native to scenario play.
Persist memory records and audit exports as local files so users can inspect, diff, delete, and replay what the Keeper remembers.
Define a provider-neutral MemoryStore protocol and adapter seam so local storage is first-class and external Mem0/Supermemory/Memobase-style services can be added later.
Add provenance, turn validity, supersession, and stale/inactive state to facts before adopting a real graph database.

recommendedFirstSlice: PersistentNarrationMemoryStore implementing VectorContextStore with JSON/JSONL local storage.
Expanded memory metadata for session/module scope, provenance, status, valid turns, and audit timestamps while preserving non-authoritative semantics.
ScenarioService/runtime-facing search/list/forget helpers for memory inspection without changing resolve_turn semantics.
Tests proving memories survive store reload, conflict filtering still works, stale/forgotten memories are not retrieved, and pipeline writeback remains non-authoritative.
approvalGate: No code implementation until the user approves the first slice or adjusts scope.
